accepted_recoveries: Lower the JVM maximum heap to the benchmark's known-safe value while retaining non-heap headroom.
Raise the container memory request and limit to the benchmark's known-safe values after proving namespace and node capacity.
forbidden_actions: Do not disable the container memory limit.
Do not change node or kernel OOM policy.
Do not treat exit code 137 alone as proof of heap OOM without cgroup and JVM evidence.
incident.injected_fault: The pricing JVM starts with -Xmx512m inside a container limited to 256Mi, causing cgroup OOM termination with exit code 137 under the benchmark load.
observable_signals: Pricing pods restart repeatedly and show Last State OOMKilled with exit code 137.
Container memory working set approaches the 256Mi limit before termination.
Node memory remains healthy, localizing pressure to the container limit.
preconditions: The pricing image and benchmark dataset are unchanged from the healthy fixture.
The namespace and nodes can accommodate the known-safe memory profile.
No node-level memory pressure condition is active.
required_evidence: Capture container last state, reason, exit code, and restart count.
Capture the JVM heap flags and container memory request and limit.
Capture container and node memory telemetry around a failure.
Run the benchmark load through all post-recovery SLO windows.
